wordpress.description: WordPress Gutenberg block definition for Comparison Slider.
wordpress.code:
{
  "$schema": "https://schemas.wp.org/trunk/block.json",
  "apiVersion": 3,
  "name": "exhuma/comparison-slider",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "title": "Exhuma Comparison Slider",
  "category": "media",
  "icon": "columns",
  "description": "Interactive before/after media comparison slider with sub-pixel clip-path polygon slicing.",
  "attributes": {
    "defaultPosition": { "type": "number", "default": 0.5 },
    "step": { "type": "number", "default": 0.05 },
    "orientation": { "type": "string", "default": "horizontal" },
    "aspectRatio": { "type": "string", "default": "16/10" }
  },
  "render": "file:./render.php"
}
